art_direction: Clinical Precision & High-End Engineering. Awwwards-level design. Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with Organic Medical Vibe. The design should look like a cutting-edge medical tech site, not a generic SaaS. It uses a Stark White base with Obsidian text and Medical Cobalt accents. Layouts should use 'Grid Borders' (The 'Technical' Look) exposing the skeleton to emphasize engineering precision.

typography.description: Cabinet Grotesk provides a modern, slightly technical but highly impactful display aesthetic for large text. IBM Plex Sans brings sterile, highly legible, monospace-adjacent precision for product specs and paragraphs.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none (Kinetic Hero)

colors.notes: Avoid all purple gradients and dark-on-dark styles. Maintain high contrast for a clinical, trustworthy feel. Color is used functionally: 95% monochrome, 5% Medical Cobalt.

visual_enhancers.borders: Exposed grid skeleton. 1px solid borders (#E4E4E7) to define sections. Remove border on the last item of a row to create an open edge.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use sharp 1px borders to ground elements rather than soft shadows. If shadows are used, use very subtle ambient shadow.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for the sticky header. bg-white/70, backdrop-blur-xl, with a 1px delicate inner stroke (border-black/5).
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (grain) in the hero section to kill digital flatness.

layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-8, p-12, p-24 for padding to give clinical breathing room.
layouts.grid: Bento 'Technical' Grid. col-span logic applied asymmetrically for product showcase and manifesto.
layouts.alignment: Left-align text by default. Only center-align if it improves visual rhythm.

motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion (initial Y offset, opacity 0 -> 1, overflow hidden on parent).
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on product cards: slight zoom of the image inside a clipped frame, border color shifts to Medical Cobalt.
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on the hero image or 3D element.
motion.marquee: Slow editorial marquee for client logos or brand statements using react-fast-marquee.

media.style: Real product photography treated deliberately. Use spotlight effects or clipped frames with neutral backgrounds.

hero_background.description: Modern Laboratory Interior - use with bg-white/40 overlay or clipped inside a central frame.

services_image.description: Scientist using pipette with test tubes

header.details: Logo left, 3-5 links center, contact phone right. Must have backdrop-blur-xl and bg-white/70.

hero_section.details: Massive masked text reveal ('Precision in Every Variable'). A clipped frame (maybe an arched or sharp rectangular window) showing the hero_background image with subtle parallax (Framer Motion). Do not use a generic full-screen overlay.

editorial_marquee.details: A slow, smooth scrolling strip featuring brand claims or client logos. High contrast text on a light gray background. Huge gap between items (gap-24).

product_catalog.details: A grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) displaying lab equipment and surgical items. Category filtering on the left or top. Each card uses the 'Technical Look' with a 1px border, white background, and a spotlight image. Hover triggers an image scale and border color shift. Includes a search input.

services_manifesto.details: Instead of basic service boxes, present them as 'Chapters' (01. Installation, 02. Maintenance, 03. Calibration). Use huge numbers (Cabinet Grotesk) and clinical descriptions. Pair with the 'services_image'.

testimonials.details: Large, beautifully typeset quotes in Cabinet Grotesk, stripped of basic card containers. Use an exposed skeleton layout with borders.

about_contact.details: No generic forms. Massive typography for the phone number and email. High-contrast section (perhaps dark background here to shift the tone before the footer, using Obsidian bg with white text).

footer.details: Huge brand name at the bottom (text-[10vw]), essential links above it. Dark theme footer to contrast with the light theme body.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use framer-motion for the masked line-by-line reveal in the hero section.
Implement @studio-freight/lenis or lenis for smooth scrolling (make sure to wrap the layout in it).
Use react-fast-marquee for the editorial marquee strip.
Use purely custom HTML/Tailwind for the layout structure, implementing the exposed grid skeleton (borders on right and bottom of elements).
Use Shadcn only for complex interactives like the catalog search or dropdown filters if needed, but style them to match the stark medical precision theme.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='product-card-1').
Do NOT use pure #000000. Use the provided Obsidian (#0A0A0A) for text.
Ensure the hero image is treated beautifully - do not slap a heavy dark overlay on it. Use a clipped frame/window approach.
Install @phosphor-icons/react for precise, high-end technical icons. Avoid emoji icons.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp borders.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
NEVER use placeholder text for images. Use the provided Image URLs.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
